description: Header file containing helper routines for D3D11 texture format support, including functions to check feature levels and format support capabilities within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: OnlyFL11_1Plus
methods.description: Checks if the device feature level is at least D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_1.

methods.name: OnlyFL10Plus
methods.description: Checks if the device feature level is at least D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_10_0.

methods.name: OnlyFL9_3
methods.description: Checks if the device feature level is exactly D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_9_3.

methods.name: SupportsFormat
methods.description: Determines if a given DXGI_FORMAT is supported based on device capabilities and support flags.
